verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no built-in recurring schedule, cron, or timer trigger. `droid exec` is explicitly a one-shot command that completes and exits, so running it on a recurring basis would depend on external CI or cron, which is a user-side or host-platform workaround. Event-triggered delegations (Linear/Jira assignment, PR review) and the vague "persistent automations" and "autopilot" phrasing are adjacent features, not documented recurring scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
